name: Custom Product Configurator for WooCommerce
author: zechkonja

sections.description:
Custom Product Configurator for WooCommerce is built for store owners who sell customizable products and want a solution that works immediately.

Instead of building configurators from scratch, you use ready-made product templates that create a complete configurator for you in one click — including fields, pricing logic, and frontend layout.

The plugin is especially suited for printed products, but also works for many other custom product types.

Who Is This Plugin For

This plugin is ideal if you sell:

  • Printed products (flyers, posters, business cards, stickers)
  • Custom furniture or made-to-measure products
  • Doors, windows, panels, or modular products
  • Any product where customers select options instead of variations

If your current workflow includes manual emails, Excel price calculations, or order clarification, this plugin replaces that process.

The Core Idea

You don’t build configurators.
You select a template and start selling.

Templates are based on real-world products and common pricing models, so you can launch faster and avoid complex setup.

How It Works (2 Steps)

Step 1: Create a Configurator in One Click

Choose a product template (for example: Printed Product).

The plugin automatically creates:
– product options
– pricing logic
– customer-friendly frontend UI

No field building. No rule configuration.

Step 2: Assign It to a WooCommerce Product

Attach the configurator to a product.

That’s it — your product is now configurable, priced correctly, and ready to order.

Templates Status

Templates are currently being rolled out.

Initial templates focus on printed products and other common real-world selling scenarios.

Want a template for your niche?
Tell us what you sell here:
https://www.wp-product-configurator.com/your-niche/

Your input directly influences which templates are built next.

Key Features

  • Ready-made product configurator templates
  • Visual configuration directly on WooCommerce product pages
  • Live price calculation
  • Clean and simple frontend UI
  • React-based admin and frontend apps
  • Works with simple and variable products
  • Performance-focused architecture

Premium Features

  • Conditional pricing rules
  • Category-based configurators
  • Advanced price add-ons
  • Priority support

Composite Products (Coming Soon)

Composite Products allow customers to build multi-part products by combining multiple items into a single configuration.

This feature is currently in development and will enable use cases such as:
– bundled or modular products
– build-your-own product kits
– products composed of multiple configurable parts
– complex product structures sold as one item

Composite Products will integrate seamlessly with existing templates and pricing logic.

Real-World Examples

This plugin is designed around actual WooCommerce businesses, not demo setups:

  • Printed products with quantity-based pricing
  • Furniture with material and size selection
  • Custom products without hundreds of variations

Live demos and examples:
https://www.wp-product-configurator.com/examples/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/product-configurator, or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Product Configurator.
  4. Create a configurator using a template.
  5. Assign it to a product.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes. The configurator works with both simple and variable WooCommerce products.

Do I need to build fields and pricing logic myself?

No. Templates handle this automatically. Customization is optional.

Can I customize the styling?

Yes. The plugin uses clean CSS classes and CSS variables.

You can add custom styles via:
Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS

Example:

.custprco-field {
background: #f97316;
}
